data.fund_type: An open-ended debt scheme investing in overnight securities. A relatively low interest rate risk and relatively low credit risk.
data.investment_objective: The investment objective of the Scheme is to provide reasonable returns commensurating with overnight call rates and providing a high level of liquidity, through investments in overnight securities having maturity / unexpired maturity of 1 business day. However, there can be no assurance that the investment objective of the scheme will be realised
data.fund_managers: Mr. Jalpan Shah & Mr. Neeraj Jain
